title: AI assistants
description: Connect your own AI assistant to EventDesk. The assistant sees exactly what you see in the app and can at most propose changes — you confirm them.

list.title: Active connections
list.emptyBody: Create a token and add it to your assistant so it can read the plan of your occasions.
list.caption: Connection tokens
list.name: Name
list.expiryNote: A token unused for {days} days expires on its own. Disconnecting takes effect immediately. “Sign out everywhere” on the account page also stops every token.

scopes.readHint: The assistant can read the plan but cannot propose anything.
scopes.read_proposeHint: The assistant can also propose task lists, wording or seating. Nothing is applied until you confirm it in the app.

create.title: Connect an assistant
create.nameHint: Only for you, so you can recognise it. For example: “The assistant on my laptop”.
create.freshBody: Creating a token is a sensitive action. Confirm with a new code on the account page, then come back here.
create.limit: You can have at most {max} active connections.

consent.title: Before you create the token
consent.lead: If you connect an assistant, the data of your occasions leaves EventDesk for the provider of the assistant you choose. EventDesk cannot control what that provider does with it.

classes.occasionDetails: Occasion details: kind, date or date-poll state, the roles you hold
classes.guestCounts: Guest and response counts — not their names, unless you have access to the guest list
classes.budgetSummaries: Budget totals per category, only if you have access to money
classes.spaceModel: The venue plan: dimensions, tables, points of interest, parking
classes.team: The occasion's team: the name or address each member appears with, and their role
classes.guestNames: The names of invited households and of their adults, only if you manage the guest list. Children appear only as a number; contact details never leave
classes.seating: Seating: how many seats each table has and how many are taken
classes.suppliers: The plan's suppliers and their booking state; amounts only if you have finance access
classes.planNotes: Plan notes and budget notes (budget notes only if you have finance access)
classes.proposals: The proposals waiting for your decision

consent.limits: The assistant receives only what you can see in the app. It does not see guests' private requests, other accounts' data, payments or the admin console.
consent.transfer: If the assistant's provider is outside the European Economic Area, the data is transferred outside the EEA. We recommend assistants hosted in the EEA.
consent.retention: EventDesk does not keep the assistant's answers — only the proposals it submits. You can disconnect the assistant at any time; access stops at once.
consent.checkbox: I understand and agree to this data being sent to my assistant

created.title: Your token
created.once: You see it only once. Copy it now; after you close the page only the last four characters stay visible.
created.howBody: In your assistant, add an MCP server (HTTP) with the address and header below.

proposalNote: The proposal changed nothing. Open the link in EventDesk to review it and confirm or discard it.

errors.consentRequired: This token is not active yet. Open {url} and accept the warning about the data sent to the assistant.
errors.readOnlyToken: This token is read-only and cannot propose changes. Create a “Read and propose” token at {url}.
errors.tooManyTokens: You already have the maximum number of active connections. Disconnect one to create another.
errors.listingNotPublic: One of the businesses is not (or no longer) public in the directory. Search again and use the ids you receive.
errors.categoryMissing: The budget category no longer exists. Read the budget again.
errors.categoryTwice: The same category appears twice in the proposal.
errors.tooManyNotes: The occasion already has the maximum number of notes. Delete some to add more.

catalogue.title: What an assistant can do
catalogue.lead: The list of tools is fixed and the same for everyone. Read tools show only what you can see in the app. Propose tools change nothing: each creates a proposal that you confirm or reject.
catalogue.caption: Tools the assistant can use
catalogue.never: There are no tools for payments, subscriptions, the admin console, other accounts' data, publishing, or sending enquiries to businesses.

tools.whoami: Confirms the connection and shows which occasions it can reach.
tools.list_occasions: Your occasions: title, kind, date, your role.
tools.get_occasion: One occasion's details: date, venue, purpose and priorities, your role, the team, how many proposals are waiting.
tools.list_tasks: An occasion's tasks, with owner, due date and status.
tools.get_rsvp_summary: How many guests answered and how many are coming — numbers only, no names.
tools.list_households: The invited households, with each one's answer and table. Only for people who manage the occasion; no contact details.
tools.list_pending_proposals: The proposals waiting for your decision.
tools.get_budget_summary: The budget by category: estimate, forecast, committed, invoiced, paid. Only with finance access.
tools.list_suppliers: The plan's suppliers and their booking state; amounts only with finance access.
tools.get_space_model: The venue plan as geometry: dimensions, tables, points of interest, parking — not the uploaded image.
tools.get_seating_summary: Seating in numbers: seats at each table, how many have no seat yet, the fit check.
tools.list_directory_filters: The categories and counties of the business directory.
tools.search_directory: Searches the public business directory. Results come in the directory's own order, with the “Featured — paid placement” label where it applies.
tools.get_listing: A business's public page in the directory.
tools.list_catalogues: Published flower catalogues, with indicative prices.
tools.propose_task_list: Proposes new tasks, with due date and owner.
tools.propose_invitation_text: Proposes the invitation wording shown to guests.
tools.propose_budget: Proposes estimates for budget categories. They appear as estimates, not quotes. Only with finance access.
tools.propose_budget_note: Proposes a note on a budget category. Only with finance access.
tools.propose_supplier_shortlist: Proposes a note listing businesses to consider. It notifies nobody and sends no enquiry.
tools.propose_seating_layout: Proposes a layout of tables and guests, checked against the space.
tools.propose_custom_table: Proposes a new table, with name and dimensions.
tools.propose_arrangement_design: Proposes a flower arrangement from the catalogues, with an indicative cost.

taskList.title: New tasks proposed: {count}
taskList.owner: Offered to {name}; they become the owner only if they accept.

invitationText.title: New invitation wording
invitationText.note: Shown on the guests' page. It stays labelled “created with an external assistant” until you edit it.

budget.title: Budget estimates proposed: {count}
budget.estimateNote: An estimate — not a quote and not a confirmed price.

shortlist.title: Businesses to consider: {count}
shortlist.noteOnly: Only a note in the plan: it does not notify the business and sends no enquiry.

notes.title: Plan notes
notes.description: Notes kept only for you and your team. They notify nobody.
notes.noEnquiry: No business was contacted. If you want, send an enquiry yourself from the business's page.

invitation.title: Invitation wording
invitation.label: Text shown to guests
invitation.hint: Shown on the guests' page, under the occasion title. Leave empty for no text.
invitation.externalNote: The current text was proposed by an external assistant and confirmed here. The label goes away when you edit it.
